newsitem.title: UK: SBC sets warrants on German government bonds.
newsitem.headline: SBC sets warrants on German government bonds.

text.p: Schweizerischer Bankverein (Deutschland) AG says it has issued 240 million call and put warrants, in 24 equal tranches, on four German government bonds.
There are three tranches of calls and three tranches of puts each on the 6.25 percent Bund due April 2006 and the 6.25 percent Bund due January 2024. All mature on March 16, 1998.

There are six tranches of warrants on the 6.0 percent Bund due 2006, three tranches of calls and three tranches of puts. They mature of 15 September 1997. There is also a further six tranches (three call and three put tranches) on the 6.0 percent Bund due February 2006. These mature on March 16, 1998.
